    "sample_size_total": 29,
    "recruitment_and_incentive": "Participants were recruited with the promise of a base payment plus performance-based earnings.",
    "analysis_plan": "Independent samples t-test comparing intimacy scores between the attention and no attention conditions.",
    "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
    "other_methods_notes": "Participants were assigned the role of Player 2 in a trivia task. The attention manipulation involved a signal on the participant's screen indicating whether the partner was monitoring their progress. One participant was excluded for suspecting the use of deception."
